proposals.title: Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis — Summary for Policymakers
proposals.why: AR6 WG1 top-level synthesis: water cycle intensification, extremes, ice loss, sea level projections under continued emissions.

proposals.title: Water Cycle Changes (Chapter 8, Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis)
proposals.why: Comprehensive AR6 chapter on projected global and regional water cycle changes, rainfall variability, and monsoons.

proposals.title: Weather and Climate Extreme Events in a Changing Climate (Chapter 11, Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis)
proposals.why: AR6 chapter assessing future changes in heavy precipitation, droughts, floods, and compound extremes at different warming levels.

proposals.title: Ocean, Cryosphere and Sea Level Change (Chapter 9, Climate Change 2021: The Physical Science Basis)
proposals.why: AR6 chapter on projected ocean warming, ice sheet and glacier loss, and global and regional sea level rise.

proposals.title: Climate Change 2023: Synthesis Report
proposals.why: Integrates all AR6 findings on water cycle, extremes, cryosphere, and sea level under continued GHG emissions.

proposals.title: Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate
proposals.why: Dedicated IPCC special report on future ocean change, sea level rise, glacier and ice sheet loss, and cryosphere impacts.

proposals.title: A systematic review of regional and global climate extremes in CMIP6 models under shared socio-economic pathways
proposals.why: Systematic review of CMIP6 projections of precipitation extremes, droughts, floods, and heatwaves across regions and scenarios.

proposals.title: State of the Global Climate 2024
proposals.why: Most recent annual WMO report tracking observed sea level, sea ice, glaciers, precipitation, and ocean heat content trends.
